answer: Each key must solve a fixed 2^24-hash proof-of-work and submit the nonce; the registry verifies it and binds it to that key. N fake keys cost N×2^24 hashes, linear in N, paid as irreversible compute by the registrant, not locked capital. Renaming cannot reset the cost because the nonce is key-bound. As the tide of Sybils hits its zenith, the ocean of registrations pays per key.
